name: MaenSat World Cup final status priority fix
fixed: Final states now win over stale live labels in World Cup cards.
Finished on penalties is shown as انتهت بركلات الترجيح, not مباشر.
Finished after extra time is shown as انتهت بعد التمديد, not مباشر.
Live extra time / live penalties still show مباشر until an explicit final status arrives.
commit_message: Fix World Cup final status priority over live labels
